Date: 2025-03-18 App. No. 17/970,034
Docket No. 036433.04606 REMARKSClaims 1-3 and 5-20 have been allowed. The Examiner contacted the undersigned today, March 18, 2025, to indicate that claim 20 was dependent from a canceled claim. Thus, by this Amendment under 37 C.F.R. 1.312 and as shown above, the Applicant has amended claim 20 to address the dependency. The Applicant respectfully submits that this Amendment does not require an additional search on the part of the Examiner, does not raise any new issues, and requires no substantial amount of additional work on the part of the Office. No new matter has been added by this amendment. It is thus submitted that this Amendment is proper under 37 C.F.R. §1.312, and, therefore, the Applicant respectfully requests that this Amendment be entered.Approval of this amendment is therefore respectfully requested.Applicant believes no fee is due with this request. However, if a fee is due, please charge our Deposit Account Number 01-2300, under number 036433.04606, from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.Customer No.: 38485 Respectfully submitted, ArentFox Schiff LLP 1301 Avenue of the Americas, 42nd Floor New York, NY 10019 By: / Paul C.
